request: Create a production-ready Docker Compose setup for this Go + Templ + HTMX Tesla monitoring app: Go app container, PostgreSQL, env vars via .env, automatic restarts, Postgres healthchecks, app/worker waits for Postgres, persistent data, no hardcoded secrets, simple enough for a small Hostinger VPS, and easy to move to another cloud provider later. Plus the deploy strategy and steps for a first-time VPS user.

tasks.title: Fix internal/config.Load() so a missing .env is not fatal (tests first)
Dockerfile (multi-stage, web + poller + migrate targets) and .dockerignore
compose.yaml, Caddyfile, migrate entrypoint, backup script, Makefile targets
Add the new deploy variables to .env.example
New Docker command reference doc: docs/1-deploy/docker.md
Update README.md, cmd/README.md, internal/config/AGENTS.md and cross-links
Verification: build, vet, gofmt and the standalone guards

decisions.what: PostgreSQL runs as a compose service with a named volume and healthcheck; DATABASE_URL alone switches to a managed host later.
decisions.why: Cheapest for a first VPS deploy. Keeps the ticket's requirement that the database host can change.

decisions.what: A one-shot migrate service runs goose over the four dirs, then exits. web and poller wait on service_completed_successfully.
decisions.why: Gives the ticket's wait-for-Postgres ordering. One command deploys. No half-migrated database.

decisions.what: Caddy runs in compose for automatic HTTPS. Only Caddy publishes ports 80 and 443.
decisions.why: Google OAuth allows plain http only for localhost. Without HTTPS nobody can log in.

decisions.what: The image is built on the VPS. No registry and no CI in this change.
decisions.why: No extra accounts or workflow files. Moving to a registry later is a one-line change.

decisions.what: The VPS starts with an empty database. No dump or restore of the local history.
decisions.why: Owner chose the simplest path knowingly. The leader raised the loss risk first.

decisions.what: A daily pg_dump on the VPS keeps 7 days, wired as a make target plus one cron line.
decisions.why: After D5 the VPS still holds data that exists nowhere else from day one.

decisions.what: Named the change platform-add-docker-compose-deploy as a single cross-cutting change, not a roadmap.
decisions.why: It touches only internal/config plus repo-root infra. openspec/config.yaml assigns platform- to cross-cutting work.

decisions.what: Put the new Docker command reference at docs/1-deploy/docker.md, a new folder, not docs/0-set-up/docker.md.
decisions.why: It is a reference the owner returns to, not a one-time setup checklist. Cross-links stop either doc becoming orphaned.

decisions.what: Dispatched the artifact worker on Sonnet rather than Opus.
decisions.why: All six design decisions were settled first and every fact pre-verified. The work was authoring, not design discovery.
